ev.adapter_reconnected: Hotspot adapter connected to '{ssid}' - disconnecting and restarting the hotspot
ev.cleanup_start: Turning hotspot off and restoring Wi-Fi settings ...

hint.test_mode: Test mode: network control off, FTP on {ip}
hint.no_adapter: No Wi-Fi adapter found for the hotspot. Is Wi-Fi switched on (airplane mode off)? With several adapters, set 'hotspot_adapter_match' in config.json.
hint.adapter_on_ssid: The hotspot adapter is connected to '{ssid}'. The hotspot then has to use its channel - this is what made the camera fail earlier (Err.1F).
hint.loopback_disabled: No network to share. The loopback adapter '{name}' is disabled - turn it on with 'Enable loopback' (Windows asks for admin rights).
hint.loopback_missing: No network to share. The loopback adapter '{name}' is not present - use 'Set up loopback' to open the hardware wizard: choose manually from a list > Network adapters > Microsoft > Microsoft KM-TEST Loopback Adapter.
hint.no_loopback: No network to share and no loopback adapter installed. Quickest fix: connect the USB stick to your phone's hotspot. Permanent fix: 'Set up loopback' (one time, admin rights).
hint.no_source: No network to share found. Connect the USB stick to a Wi-Fi.
hint.source_no_internet: The hotspot shares from '{name}' without internet - irrelevant for the camera.
hint.band: Hotspot band is {band} instead of 5 GHz - transfers will be much slower.
hint.ssid_mismatch: The hotspot is named '{ssid}', the camera expects '{expected}'.
hint.ip_missing: Hotspot IP {ip} is missing - the hotspot is not running or uses a different IP.
hint.uplink_weak: The USB stick has only {signal} % signal to '{ssid}' - irrelevant for the camera, but the internet will be slow.
hint.vpn: VPN active ({names}) - VPNs often break hotspot sharing. Disconnect it for the transfer.
hint.ethernet: LAN cable active ({name}) - can be used as the sharing source.
hint.uplink_channel_busy: USB stick channel {channel} is {util} % busy ({count} transmitters) - the internet may stutter.
hint.hotspot_channel_shared: Hotspot channel {channel} is shared with other transmitters: {count} (up to {util} % busy).
hint.no_ftp_connect: A device is in the hotspot, but no FTP connection has arrived for >30 s. Check: camera profile address {ip}, port {port}, PASV ON; Windows Firewall for Python (public networks) or your antivirus.
hint.login_failed: {count}x login failed - check user '{user}' / password in the camera profile.
hint.bad_files: {count} file(s) incomplete or suspicious ({names}{more}) - upload again from the camera, the complete version replaces the truncated one automatically.
hint.aborted: {count} transfer(s) aborted - reduce the distance, and if needed enable 'keep connection alive' in the camera profile.
hint.battery: Battery at {percent} % - plug in the charger, otherwise the transfer will break off.
hint.slow: Only {rate} MB/s - check distance/housing, or the hotspot is running on 2.4 GHz.
prog.anchor.first_was_present: first file was already present (full upload)
prog.waiting.need_first_file_range: Waiting for the first file to determine the start.

prog.note.range_vs_card: Number range much larger than the card count - check the first image.
prog.err.number_not_recognized: Image number not recognized, e.g. 7100 or DSC_7100.NEF
file.demo_truncated: truncated: image data ends at 64.3 MB

ps.scan_fallback: New scan not possible, using the last Windows results: {error}

ui.ads.title: Connections on the laptop
ui.ads.none_test: No adapter data in test mode.
ui.ch.title: Channel usage
ui.ch.note: Bars: highest reported channel utilisation in percent, number above: count of transmitters. Windows picks the hotspot channel itself; it only shows up if the USB stick sees it in the scan.
ui.ch.no_scan: No scan yet. The USB stick has to be plugged in.
ui.files.title: Files
ui.files.meta: MB/s per file, newest on the right
ui.prog.title: What's coming today?
ui.prog.help_files: The number the camera shows when the upload starts. Most accurate: every file counts, RAW and JPEG separately.
ui.prog.help_last: Number of the newest image on the card. The start is automatically the image after the last file already in the target folder. RAW+JPEG counts as one image, after 9999 it continues at 0001.
ui.prog.help_card: The total count from the camera's playback view. Images already transferred are included. The card is matched via the first incoming files; the first image can be corrected if needed.
ui.prog.confirm_reset: Reset this session's counters and the expectation?
ui.prog.extra_hint: Usually RAW+JPEG, videos, or images added after the number was read.
ui.prog.stalled_files: No transfer for a minute, but {n} files have not arrived.
ui.prog.stalled_images: No transfer for a minute, but {n} images are missing.
ui.prog.gaps: Gaps in the number sequence (could also be images deleted in the camera):
ui.prog.flagged: Flagged as missing. Upload again from the camera, images that arrive disappear from the list.
ui.prog.fine_deleted: Fine as is, deleted in the camera
ui.prog.bad_hint: Counted as missing until a complete version arrives.
